summary: Frontend-only E2E of the 'Celebratory Success Feedback' plan. All 8 assertions pass. Verified across CRUD on /leads as Office Admin (blr1@finflow.com): centered overlay with data-testid=celebration-overlay + celebration-success/celebration-error, caption maps correctly (Added/Updated/Deleted), auto-dismisses <1.5s, backdrop has pointer-events:none (non-blocking), no double sonner toast on CRUD success, error path routes through the centered red overlay with the reason ('Lead name is required'), submit button shows 'Saving…' disabled state, and no false positives on login or page navigation.

verification_results.1_login_no_celebration: PASS — After login POST /api/auth/login, no [data-testid=celebration-overlay] appeared. /auth is correctly excluded in CELEBRATE_EXCLUDES.
verification_results.2_nav_and_GETs_no_celebration: PASS — Navigating to /leads and switching to 'All leads' tab (list GETs, stats GETs, campaigns GETs, auto-refresh) does NOT pop any overlay.
verification_results.3_create_added: PASS — POST /api/leads 201 → overlay kind='success', data-testid=celebration-success, caption='Added'. No accompanying sonner top-right success toast (patched toast.success swallows within 1.6s window). Overlay auto-dismisses within ~1.25s.
verification_results.4_update_updated: PASS — PATCH via 'Add note' from LeadDetailDialog → overlay data-testid=celebration-success, caption='Updated'.
verification_results.5_delete_deleted: PASS — DELETE /api/leads/{id} after AlertDialog confirm → overlay data-testid=celebration-success, caption='Deleted'.
verification_results.6_error_overlay: PASS — Submitting lead form with empty required name → toast.error path patched → centered overlay with data-testid=celebration-error, kind='error', caption="Didn't go through", data-testid=celebration-message='Lead name is required'. Styled in app red theme; form remained open with values intact.
verification_results.7_in_progress_button: PASS — During save the submit button text changes to 'Saving…' and has disabled attribute set (prevents double submit).
verification_results.8_non_blocking_backdrop: PASS — getComputedStyle(overlay).pointerEvents === 'none'. Underneath page usable, overlay fades on its own.
verification_results.regression_crud_still_functions: PASS — Records actually created/updated/deleted (verified via list/search, journey entry 'Test celebration note' appeared, then lead removed).

critical_code_review_comments: celebrate.js patches sonnerToast.success/error at module scope on import — good single source of truth. The 1600ms swallow window (recentlyCelebrated) is a reasonable buffer to avoid double feedback while preserving standalone toasts (e.g., 'Copied').

api.js CELEBRATE_EXCLUDES correctly filters /auth, /push, /webauthn, /notifications, /login-attempts, /uploads. Consider also adding /read or view-tracking mutation endpoints if any exist that are technically POST/PATCH but background — none observed in this test run.
CelebrationOverlay uses useSyncExternalStore correctly and auto-dismisses via a single timeout (SUCCESS 1250ms / ERROR 2200ms) — matches spec. Backdrop click also dismisses which is a nice touch.

The AlertDialog 'Delete lead' confirmation and the primary 'Delete' button in LeadDetailDialog share the same visible label 'Delete' — the second matches by role/name. Tests must click the last matching button. Not a bug, just noted.
seed_data_creation: Two temporary leads named CELEB_TEST_<epoch> were created for the test and both deleted afterward. Dataset restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is production-ready per this test pass. The overlay is transient (~1.25s / ~2.2s) — assert IMMEDIATELY after clicking the trigger using wait_for_selector([data-testid=celebration-overlay]) with state='attached' and read caption before it fades. The AlertDialog 'Delete lead?' shows a second Delete button — use get_by_role('button', name='Delete').all()[-1] to click confirm. Save button text becomes 'Saving…' and disabled='' (empty string) — check either signal. Feature works for Office Admin; Super Admin and Staff should behave identically since the wiring is at the shared axios interceptor + toast patch layer, not per-role.
